definitions.explanation: A tall body or physique. Used to describe someone who is notably tall. Functions as a noun that modifies other nouns with の.

examples.japanese: {長身|ちょうしん}の{男性|だんせい}が{立|た}っていた。
examples.english: A tall man was standing there.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{長身|ちょうしん}で{目立|めだ}つ。
examples.english: She stands out because of her tall stature.

examples.japanese: バスケットボール{選手|せんしゅ}らしい{長身|ちょうしん}の{若者|わかもの}がカフェに{入|はい}ってきた。
examples.english: A tall young person who looked like a basketball player came into the café.

notes:
A descriptive noun used as a modifier with の. More literary and precise than simply saying {背|せ}が{高|たか}い (tall). Often appears in written descriptions of people's appearance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長身|ちょうしん}の{男性|だんせい}/{女性|じょせい} (a tall man/woman)
- {長身|ちょうしん}で{細身|ほそみ} (tall and slender)
- {長身|ちょうしん}を{生|い}かす (to make use of one's height)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {背|せ}が{高|たか}い — tall (everyday adjective)
- {長身|ちょうしん} — tall stature (descriptive noun, more literary)
